fields.label: Experience Level
fields.note: POST body array of experience band slugs from the portal facet (entry_level, middle_level, senior_level).

notes: TCS's own iBegin candidate portal. Requires a session: GET /candidate/next/en-IN/landing (sets XSRF-TOKEN), then POST /candidate/next/api/en-IN/search/jobs with header next-xsrf-token and JSON body {includeRegularJob, includeWalkIn, searchTerms[], jobLocationFilters[], jobDomainFilters[], experienceLevelFilters[], skillFilters[], recentSortOrder, page, resultsPerPage (10/25/50)}. searchTerms:['engineer'] returned totalElements=178 for en-IN versus 1389 unfiltered; the response facets returned location slugs, domain ids 2130-2137, experience levels and skills. The marketing entry tcs.com/careers is Akamai-protected (403) but is not the search endpoint.
